questions.q: At what age did Kim Perell become unemployed in 2001?
questions.why: She was 23 when she was broke and unemployed.

questions.q: What strategy does Perell suggest for testing a big vision?
questions.why: She advises testing a vision on a smaller scale first.

questions.q: Which famous entrepreneur is used as an example of resilience?
questions.why: Perell cites Elon Musk's setbacks as a resilience example.

questions.q: What is the main benefit of taking small actions toward a vision?
questions.why: Small steps move you closer to your vision.

questions.q: Which term describes the ability to adapt to setbacks?
questions.why: The book defines resiliency as adapting to challenges.
